title.narrative: Increasing knowledge on semiconductors for industry and knowledge institutes Vietnam 2025

description.narrative: Vietnam aims to enhance its role in the high-tech industry by building a small-scale semiconductor chip manufacturing plant in 2025. This cutting-edge facility would aid in the research, design and production of locally made semiconductor chips, fulfilling domestic needs and increasing the country’s contribution to the global semiconductor supply chain. The Netherlands has strategic interest in boosting Vietnam's semiconductor industry to enhance global supply diversity. Currently, Vietnam is attracting investments from Japan, Korea, USA and the Netherlands, particularly in high-tech manufacturing sectors like semiconductors. Despite various advantages, Vietnamese companies lack international collaboration and especially lack access to a highly skilled labour force. Moreover, Vietnam’s training capacity for the semiconductor sector is low. This project aims to enhance talent mobilisation among Vietnamese students in the field of the Semiconductor industry. Vietnamese’s students will be given access to expertise through the participation in the Eindhoven semiconductor summer school. Acquired expertise will be passed on to a variety of stakeholders, including universities and the private sector in the field (small- and medium-sized enterprises (SME’s)). The project also enables potential partnerships among knowledge institutes and semiconductor industry and facilitates peer-to-peer learning.
